version.changelog: 梦境记录、修饰、分析与搜索工具。自动捕捉梦境描述，进行文学化修饰，按日期记录到markdown文档，并分析梦境意象频率。支持关键词搜索、意象搜索、日期搜索和多种格式导出。

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its stated purpose (recording, analyzing, and exporting dream text); it has no external installs, no requested credentials, and no hidden network behavior — main user concern is that it persistently writes user-provided dream text to a fixed workspace path.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, SKILL.md, and the included Python script all implement the same functionality: detect dream text, extract imagery, produce a poetic title, store entries, generate simple stats, search, and export. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or network endpoints requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the script operate on user-provided text and local files only. The SKILL.md describes trigger phrases and commands consistent with the script. The instructions do not direct reading of unrelated system files, environment variables, or external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only plus an included script). There are no downloads, package installs, or external URLs referenced. The script is self-contained and uses only the standard library.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no credentials or environment variables, which is appropriate. It does, however, write and persist user dream content and stats to an absolute path: /root/.openclaw/workspace/memory (dreams.md, imagery_stats.json, and export files). Persisting potentially sensitive personal text to disk is expected for a journal but is a privacy consideration—especially on multi-user systems or when backups/remote storage are present.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated or cross-skill privileges. It creates and writes only to its own workspace memory directory and does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims and does not request credentials or network access. Before installing, consider privacy implications: it will persist all recorded dream text and imagery statistics to /root/.openclaw/workspace/memory (dreams.md, imagery_stats.json, and export files). If you run on a shared machine or if backups/sync are enabled, those files could be accessible to others. If you prefer, inspect or modify scripts/record_dream.py to change the storage path to a safer location (e.g., a user-specific directory), or add encryption before writing. Also review trigger phrases and test for false positives if you don't want casual chat saved automatically.
